title: America The Beautiful
lyrics_synced:
[00:00.00] Piano: Brent Baileywww.wizard.net/~dsr/members.aol.com/divtune/
[00:02.40] .
[00:12.59] Oh beautiful for spacious skies,
[00:17.69] For amber waves the grain,
[00:22.83] For purple mountain majesties
[00:27.91] Above the fruited plain!
[00:32.98] America! America!
[00:38.12] God shed His grace on thee,
[00:43.23] And crown thy good with brotherhood
[00:48.33] From sea to shining sea!
[00:53.48] Oh beautiful for pilgrim feet,
[00:58.56] Whose stern, impassioned stress
[01:03.70] A thoroughfare for freedom beat
[01:08.79] Across the wilderness!
[01:13.85] America! America!
[01:19.02] God mend thine ev'ry flaw,
[01:24.14] Confirm thy soul in self control,
[01:29.20] Thy liberty in law!
[01:34.33] Oh beautiful for heroes proved
[01:39.43] In liberating strife,
[01:44.53] Who more than self their country loved,
[01:49.63] And mercy more than life!
[01:54.71] America! America!
[01:59.84] May God thy gold refine,
[02:04.94] Till all success be nobleness,
[02:10.05] And ev'ry grace divine!
[02:15.13] Oh beautiful for patriot dream
[02:20.27] That sees beyond the years
[02:25.38] Thine alabaster cities gleam,
[02:30.52] Undimmed by human tears!
[02:35.57] America! America!
[02:40.72] God shed His grace on thee,
[02:45.81] And crown thy good with brotherhood
[02:50.93] From sea to shining sea!
